exclusions: All unlisted untracked paths and raw/redundant evidence are excluded from proposed change scope.
Build output directories, .next, out, node_modules, caches, generated bundles and temporary runtime data are excluded.
Operational .env files, secrets, credentials, real accounts/data, Docker resources and unrelated work are excluded.
Only the explicitly listed paths in scope.entries are proposed for change; selected_evidence entries are supporting records, not automatic PR source inclusion.
The manifest does not hash itself or the local PR-body draft; R5/R6/R7/R8 generated body/manifest paths are excluded from the WIP status digest.
